title: NJ Capybaras
description: Adds realistic capybaras to Minecraft with unique behaviors, breeding, custom drops, and immersive world generation.
body:
# Capy Mod

Bring adorable capybaras to Minecraft!

Capy Mod adds naturally spawning capybaras to Minecraft with multiple unique variants, breeding mechanics, and dedicated server support. Explore your world, discover every capybara variant, and bring a relaxing new mob to your adventures.

---

# Features

## 🦫 Four Unique Variants

Capy Mod currently includes four different capybara variants:

- Brown
- Dark
- Golden
- Rust

Each variant has its own appearance, giving players more variety while exploring the world.

---

## 🌍 Natural Spawning

Capybaras naturally generate in suitable biomes without changing Minecraft's vanilla gameplay.

Simply install the mod and start exploring.

---

## ❤️ Breeding

Breed capybaras to grow your own family.

Baby capybaras are fully supported and allow players to collect even more variants.

---

## 🥚 Capybara Spawn Egg

A Capybara Spawn Egg is included for Creative Mode, map makers, and testing.

---

## 👥 Multiplayer Compatible

Capy Mod works perfectly in both Singleplayer and Multiplayer.

Enjoy capybaras together with your friends on Fabric servers.

---

## 🖥️ Dedicated Server Support

The mod is fully compatible with dedicated Fabric servers.

---

# Why Install Capy Mod?

- Adds a completely new peaceful mob.
- Multiple naturally spawning variants.
- Vanilla-friendly gameplay.
- Lightweight and performance-friendly.
- Multiplayer compatible.
- Easy to install.
- Regular updates with new content planned.

---

# Requirements

- Minecraft **1.21.11**
- Fabric Loader
- Fabric API

---

# Supported Languages

Currently available in:

- 🇺🇸 English
- 🇩🇪 German

Additional translations are always welcome.

---

# Current Status

⚠️ Alpha v0.1.0

Capy Mod is currently in active development.

This is the first public Alpha release. While the core features are already playable, many improvements and additional content are planned for future versions.

Because this is an early Alpha version, **always create backups before using the mod on important worlds or servers.**

---

# Planned Features

The roadmap currently includes:

- 🤍 Albino Capybara
- 🥙 Gyros
- 💩 Poop
- 🎵 Custom sounds
- ✨ More animations
- 🦫 Additional capybara variants
- 🍃 More natural behaviors
- 🎮 More gameplay features
- 💡 Community-requested features

---

# Feedback

Found a bug?

Have an idea?

Your feedback helps improve Capy Mod.

Bug reports, feature requests, balancing suggestions, and general feedback are always appreciated.

---

# Looking for Contributors

We are currently looking for:

- 💻 Developers
- 🧪 Testers

Development access is restricted to approved contributors.

Interested developers can apply through our Discord server.

---

# Community

Stay up to date with development and future projects.

- 🎮 Discord — Support, bug reports, community, and developer applications.
- 💻 GitHub — Source code, issue tracking, and development progress.

Thank you for supporting Capy Mod!

Every download, suggestion, bug report, and piece of feedback helps improve the project and shape future updates.
